also_repaired: a singular regime no longer crashes the run; it is recorded as unfitted and the others proceed, per the preregistration local-mask semantics

barrier_held.note: the fit crashed rather than producing an unidentifiable model

cause.detail: lever_geometry used the mean PROMPT length as the context. R1, R6 and R8 have 73-111 token prompts, so min(context, window+16) returned the context for every window: the window axis carried no information, the design matrix lost rank, and the fit raised a singular-design error.
cause.fix: context is now prompt + generated/2, the mean KV length over the measured steps, giving 3 distinct KV values for the short regimes and 5 for the long ones

operator_note: the waiter used pgrep -f with a pattern that matched its own shell command line, so it reported the dead run as RUNNING for ~80 minutes
